name: Eternal Secret
source:
You come back to school at the beginning of second semester. A lot has changed during your absence. Are you able to solve the mystery which not many people know about?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1489020/Eternal_Secret/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你在第二学期开始时回到学校。你不在期间发生了很多变化。你能解开很多人不知道的谜团吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1489020/Eternal_Secret/]Steam[/url]]
